description.value: The Beaver Valley Public Library is a community public library serving the Beaver Valley area of the Kootenays, located on traditional Indigenous territory. Beyond books, it offers a notable Library of Things collection that includes items like hiking backpacks, food dehydrators, and an egg incubator — a practical resource for adventurous visitors. Touring cyclists passing through Fruitvale will find free computer and internet access as well as a range of digital and in-person programming.
